تستمدوا (form X)
# تَسْتَمِدُّوا (tastamiddū) /tas.ta.mid.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
# تُسْتَمَدُّوا (tustamaddū) /tus.ta.mad.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَدَّ (istamadda)
